metadata.program: SkyraSoft HBOS Public Distribution & Multi-Tenant Platform Integrity Program

atomic_provisioning_sequence.name: PAYLOAD_VALIDATION_AND_NORMALIZATION
atomic_provisioning_sequence.action: Validate input fields, confirm password, normalize email to lowercase, enforce rate limits

atomic_provisioning_sequence.name: DATABASE_TRANSACTION_START
atomic_provisioning_sequence.action: Begin DB::beginTransaction() with strict rollback on any exception

atomic_provisioning_sequence.name: BUSINESS_TENANT_CREATION
atomic_provisioning_sequence.action: Insert into businesses (name, currency, type, created_at)

atomic_provisioning_sequence.name: PRIMARY_BRANCH_PROVISIONING
atomic_provisioning_sequence.action: Insert into branches (business_id, name: "Main Branch", code: "MAIN", is_primary: true, status: "active")

atomic_provisioning_sequence.name: USER_IDENTITY_CREATION
atomic_provisioning_sequence.action: Insert into users (name, email, password: Hash::make, business_id, branch_id, role: "Business Owner", is_active: true)

atomic_provisioning_sequence.name: MEMBERSHIP_PIVOT_SYNC
atomic_provisioning_sequence.action: Sync business_user (business_id, user_id) and branch_user (business_id, branch_id, user_id)

atomic_provisioning_sequence.name: DEFAULT_FINANCIAL_ACCOUNT_PROVISIONING
atomic_provisioning_sequence.action: Create default "Main Cash" financial account (type: "cash", business_id, branch_id, is_active: true)

atomic_provisioning_sequence.name: DEFAULT_SETTINGS_INITIALIZATION
atomic_provisioning_sequence.action: Seed essential business settings (receipt format, invoice prefix, fiscal start)

atomic_provisioning_sequence.name: SANCTUM_TOKEN_ISSUANCE
atomic_provisioning_sequence.action: Issue plainTextToken with active business context payload and return HTTP 201
